fields.description: The File this prose belongs to, by name. Data and unique rather than a Link so the row is addressable as `Doc Body/<file>` — one statement to load, no filter.
fields.label: Doc

fields.description: The document as ProseMirror JSON: the source of truth, and the only representation the editor reads back. Replaced whole on every save.
fields.label: Content

fields.description: What that JSON renders to, written on the same save. Everything that is not the editor reads this one — search, the preview, print, export, a mail body — so none of them has to load an editor to find out what the document says.
fields.label: Html

fields.description: How the page is set: width, typeface, line spacing, and whether it is locked against accidental typing. The reader's choices about one document, not the workspace's about all of them.
fields.label: Settings

fields.description: Bytes of content plus html. What the storage meter counts for a document, since it has no object behind it.
fields.label: Byte Size

fields.description: How many saves this document has had. `File Version` rows point at it, which is how the history panel knows whether what it is showing is the current text.
fields.label: Head Seq
